message.content: Hola. I need to send a quick message to the flamenco studio. I’m thinking of switching my class from Wednesday to Thursday morning, but I’m not sure yet. Can you draft something polite for me?

content.text: Claro, Inés. Here is a draft you can send: "Hola, I’m considering moving my class to Thursday morning. Is there space available, and what are the details? Let me know so I can decide. Thanks!" Does that sound right?

message.content: Yes, that’s perfect. Send it. Also, while you’re there, could you check my CaixaBank San Bernardo balance? I need to know if I have enough for the new class fee before I commit.

content.text: I’ve sent the message. Regarding your balance, I can see your current available funds in your CaixaBank San Bernardo account. It is sufficient for the class fee, but I recommend keeping a buffer for your weekly expenses.

message.content: Good. Okay, now help me with dinner. I have chicken breasts and some potatoes. What can I make that’s quick? I have to pick up Carmen and Diego from school later, and I have to go to the Palacio de Justicia for paperwork after that.

content.text: For chicken and potatoes, a simple *pollo al horno* (roast chicken) with wedges of potato and olive oil would work well. It’s hands-off while you handle the court visit. I’ll add the ingredients to your shopping list if you need anything else.

message.content: No, I have everything. Just make sure the timing works. If I leave for the Palacio de Justicia at 4 PM, will the chicken be ready?

content.text: If you put it in the oven at 2:30 PM, it will be ready by 4 PM. I’ve set a reminder for 2:20 PM to start cooking so you have time to get ready for your trip to the Palacio de Justicia.

message.content: Thanks. One last thing, can you update my calendar? I need to block out Thursday morning for the potential new flamenco class, just in case they say yes.

content.text: Done. I’ve blocked Thursday morning on your calendar for the flamenco class trial. I’ll also remind you to confirm the booking once you hear back from the studio.
